name: Ethereum DAI Phishing , $55.4M
rootCause: On August 20, 2024, a phishing attack compromised control over a DeFi Saver Proxy. The attacker induced the victim to sign a transaction that changed proxy ownership, then withdrew over $55 million DAI from a Maker vault. The attacker convinced the victim to sign a transaction changing ownership of their DeFi Saver Proxy contract. This allowed the attacker to seize control of the connected Maker vault and withdraw all DAI collateral. No contract bug was involved; the incident was enabled by phishing-induced unauthorized permission change.
